entries.claim: Dryad DOI 10.7941/D1N33Q contains three years of Building 59 energy, HVAC, environmental and occupancy data from more than 300 sensors/meters.
entries.source: Dryad dataset and 2022 Scientific Data publication

entries.claim: Published building description: four floors and about 10,400 m2 conditioned space; office floors are third and fourth levels.
Office areas use raised-floor underfloor air distribution and four rooftop units.
Dataset description reports two monitored office floors at 2,325 m2 each, while a later Building 59 field-control study reports approximately 6,038 m2 office HVAC study area.
entries.action: Resolve using source metadata/geometry before freezing EnergyPlus floor area.

entries.claim: 2020 contains control-regime changes including MPC periods, so it should not be silently mixed into a stationary baseline calibration.
The monitored office HVAC system uses four water-cooled-DX RTUs supplying UFAD plenums, with 50 hydronic-reheat UFTs; the RTU fans operated at the same speed.
The nominal 117 kW UFT-heating heat pump was air-source before March 2019 and water-source afterward.
entries.implication: Do not fit one immutable plant model across this change.

entries.claim: A wildfire event occurred from 2018-11-12 through 2018-11-20, and published operations documentation describes outdoor-air damper closure during wildfire events.
entries.implication: Exclude or explicitly model the event in a 2018 baseline calibration.

entries.claim: The RTU mixed-air-temperature sensors were identified as inaccurate because of installation and were replaced in early 2021.
entries.implication: Do not use these points as calibration targets or control-truth signals.

entries.claim: The first calibration target must bind office/HVAC panel measurements to the modeled scope, including an explicit disposition for unrecorded north-wing lighting.
entries.resolution_action: Freeze real file, column, units, timezone, and meter-scope bindings.

entries.claim: A campus weather station approximately 300 m northeast of the building provides 15-minute weather measurements for the data period.
entries.implication: Use reconstructed measured-year weather rather than a TMY for actual-year scorecards.

entries.claim: Berkeley Lab is supplied from PG&E 115-kV transmission lines through the Grizzly substation and historically benefited from 115-kV transmission-line rates rather than ordinary 12-kV primary rates.
entries.source: Berkeley Lab Currents, April 4 2003, Grizzly Substation article
entries.implication: Do not assume Building 59 was billed as a standalone standard PG&E commercial retail account.

entries.claim: The exact historical Building 59 cost allocation/rate assignment for 2018-2020 has not been proven from the Dryad dataset.
entries.action: Obtain campus procurement/rate evidence and a defensible Building 59 allocation method before tariff evidence VERIFIED. Standard PG&E B-19/E-20 may be useful only with evidence CANDIDATE unless proven applicable.
